subject.title: feat: trace Claude Code CLI model calls

question: Should OpenClaw permanently classify opaque CLI agent turns as `model.call` spans, and may diagnostic output capture include non-visible reasoning blocks?
rationale: These choices define durable telemetry semantics and a sensitive-content boundary; tests can prove implementation consistency but cannot choose the public diagnostics contract.

options.title: Preserve request-scoped model calls
options.body: Use run or turn spans for opaque CLI execution and restrict output capture to visible assistant content.

options.title: Approve the expanded contracts
options.body: Keep turn-valued model calls and reasoning capture only with explicit owner approval, exporter compatibility documentation, and a separately named reasoning opt-in.

recommendation.title: Preserve request-scoped model calls
recommendation.body: Use run or turn spans for opaque CLI execution and restrict output capture to visible assistant content.

likelyOwner.reason: The available history and PR timeline make this the strongest diagnostics-area routing candidate.
